nodes.name: forma
nodes.func: forma — present your architecture instead of slides. Thin CLI dispatcher over the lib/ engine. Every subcommand is a plain Node script, so any agent (or a human with no AI) drives the same contract. The engine is model-agnostic.

nodes.func: forma init — seed a c4-topology.json from the repo's real source directories. BEST-EFFORT: gives a valid, non-empty starting point (no cold-start). The human/agent then curates groupings, context externals, and plain-language descriptions.

nodes.name: serve
nodes.func: forma serve — tiny static server for the interactive viewer + model. Local dev only.
